description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy related to leave entitlement handling within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It sets up test scenarios, mocks dependencies, and verifies behaviors related to leave entitlement consumption strategies.

classes.name: FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategyTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy, containing various test scenarios for leave entitlement handling logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating instances of the strategy and populating test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeNoEntitlements
methods.description: Tests behavior when no leave entitlements are available during leave creation; expects null return unless allowNoEntitlements is true.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementBeforeApply
methods.description: Verifies handling when an entitlement exists before the leave application date, ensuring correct entitlement deduction.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementBeforeAssign
methods.description: Checks behavior when entitlement exists before the leave assign date, testing change tracking for entitlement usage.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementAfterApply
methods.description: Assesses handling of entitlement after leave is applied, including deduction and updating current entitlement states.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementAfterAssign
methods.description: Evaluates the deduction process after leave assignment, ensuring correct alignment of entitlement changes.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementNotSufficientApply
methods.description: Tests scenario where entitlement has insufficient days to cover the leave, expecting null or proper handling.

methods.name: xtestHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementNotSufficientAssign
methods.description: A disabled (prefixed with 'x') test for entitlement insufficiency during leave assignment; possibly for future or skipped tests.

methods.name: xtestGetLeaveWithoutEntitlementDateLimitsForLeaveBalance
methods.description: Another disabled test regarding leave balance date limits retrieval, indicating an unfinished or intentionally skipped test.

methods.name: verifyEntitlements
methods.description: Helper method for testing and verifying that the returned entitlement states match expected current and changed values.
